status: protocol only; zero in-game trials performed
execution: On the user's supported MCC/Xbox system. CLAUDE.md prohibits launching MCC/Halo on this Mac.
design_policy: Suggested repeatability thresholds and increments below are engineering choices, not extracted Reach constants.
record_per_trial: landing minus takeoff surface height WU
actual launch setback and landing inset WU
video/frame timestamps and observed contact positions if measurable

stages.setup: Wide, level stock deck with unobstructed headroom and an unambiguous world-coordinate scale; stand still at a known point.
measure: horizontal displacement versus elapsed time from rest
speed retention and control while airborne
stages.purpose: Verify extracted physical units and discrete time integration rather than fit only one successful gap.

stages.setup: Two wide, level, upright stock platforms; fixed equal top-surface heights; approach markers; vary edge-to-edge gap, not origin spacing.
axes: from rest versus full running approach
stages.spacing: Coarse sweep around model prediction, then 0.05 WU increments near the transition; reset launch state for each trial.
stages.purpose: Determine observed repeatable success envelope and narrow the model's range/contact error.

stages.setup: Repeat with landing surface above and below takeoff by -0.5, -0.25, 0, +0.25 and +0.5 WU; omit any offset above the recovered apex and add the actual course's larger drops/raises.
axes: same techniques and approach lengths as level_gap
stages.purpose: Verify descending landing time, front-face clearance and landing contact rather than assume a flat-gap cap applies to raised blocks.

stages.setup: Run-up lengths 0, 0.25, 0.5, 1 and 2 WU, extended until speed saturates; then representative two/three-jump chains with turns and actual block widths.
measure: minimum approach to reach intended speed
stages.purpose: A full-speed isolated jump does not certify a jump approached from a small previous block.

stages.setup: Actual obstacle/ceiling clearance, under-platform supports and safe recovery/respawn route; check representative lateral misses and falls.
measure: checkpoint/respawn behavior immediately after spawn and after traits expire
stages.purpose: Verify the entire traversable body path and the gametype's state transitions.

stages.setup: Only if the course permits Sprint/Evade/Jetpack, slopes/tilts, moving pieces, Elite players, or multiplayer conditions: add each as a separately calibrated profile.
stages.purpose: Do not reuse a standard standing-Spartan/no-ability envelope for different movement or collision conditions.

acceptance_policy.repeatable_boundary: At least 10 controlled attempts per candidate near the transition. Record counts, not a lone best jump; require 10/10 controlled successes in each of two sessions for every required jump family, and test wider gaps to bracket failures.
acceptance_policy.margin: Derive construction allowance from measured model error, launch/landing dispersion and desired difficulty. Use a conservative gap below the repeatable boundary; document the allowance in WU.
acceptance_policy.model_validation: Reserve some height/run-up/platform combinations as held-out checks; avoid validating only on trials used to fit the model.
acceptance_policy.release: Every required obstacle type/technique and representative chained course segment must pass the locked-profile trials. Retest after game/variant/profile/platform-geometry changes.
